summary: M0 model-only verdict: ESCALATE @ 0.70. New inbox forwarding rule (e.oz.archive@aegean.edu via OWA) indicates potential persistence/exfiltration. Authentications are successful but geographically anomalous for an Aegean University account: same IP/device (LT-7701) in Manisa, Turkey via Turkcell every day at 08:10, with zero MFA prompts across all eight logins. Cannot confirm whether this is the legitimate user traveling or an attacker; insufficient evidence to classify as benign or confirmed account takeover. Potential exposure exists, so human review is needed to verify travel status, MFA policy, rule legitimacy, and mailbox activity.
